meta.tagline: Helltides are home base. Nodes → Wyrms → Maggots.
meta.plan: Funnel War Plan points into Helltide nodes to unlock guaranteed Hell Wyrm Maggots (biggest XP). Ruptures and Cinder collection happen inside Helltides for free. Undercity Attunement rank-ups are a solo burst option. The Wyrm sheet / Helltides.com is the map.

guide.title: Difficulty ladder
guide.html:
LevelDo this
StartNormal (Hard for more XP if you can handle it)
~15Swap to Hard when comfortable. Bank ~800 Cinders first, they carry over
~50Move to Expert / Penitent to prep Torment 1
60+Clear Pit 10 → unlock Torment 1 → farm ancestrals

Both players stay on the same difficulty so XP and scaling line up.

guide.title: Leveling route

items.text: Unlock War Plans in Skovos, then talk to the Cube for board level 2
Helltides to ~15. S14: Helltide War Plan progress = collect 75 Cinders (250 in Torment I+), not chest-opening
Reach 4 Helltide nodes → Hell Wyrms can spawn Maggots
Reach 14 Helltide nodes → Maggots guaranteed (the XP jump)
Farm Hell Wyrms / Maggots, ride between spawns, keep Threat Meter above half
(Solo) Undercity ~25+: spec ~4 nodes, boss ×4, chain Attunement Ranks 1→4. Splits the party — save for solo play

guide.html: Also worth doing: chase goblins (gear/mats) · temper from level 10 using the per-slot recipes in each gear tracker (Barb weapons: Crit Strike Chance; Paladin: Arbiter Duration + HP) · gear check every 10 levels to 35 then every 5 · Strongholds ~45 for fast XP · Forgotten Wisdom sigils (XP globes on kills) · Capstones give 2 skill points on first clear (verify S14 levels in-game).

guide.title: War Plans playbook
guide.html:
Spending order (Helltide method — ours): reroll War Plans to take as many Helltide nodes as possible. 4 nodes → first center-path unlock (Wyrms can spawn Maggots) · 14 nodes → Maggots guaranteed.

  • Chests give no XP. Cliptis's rule: open a single chest then leave and keep progressing — spend Cinders only when you actually need gear.
  • Wyrm loop: ride between Hell Wyrm spawns on your mount, kill each, move straight to the next (the Wyrm sheet / Helltides.com is the map). Keep the Threat Meter above half.
  • Whispers: many Helltide objectives feed Whispers — free bonus XP on top.
  • Undercity (solo option, 25+): needs 4 Undercity nodes for the right-side unlock. First 4 runs: ignore everything, sprint to the boss, kill it. Attunement Ranks reward XP globes — Rank 1: 1, Rank 2: 2, Rank 3: 3, Rank 4: 4 — and they are NOT auto-collected, walk over them. From Rank 4 on, pure boss-sprint repeats.
  • Balanced alternative: rotate Helltides, Undercity, Nightmare Dungeons and Hordes — slightly slower XP but more materials for Tempering/Enchanting and less monotony.

Sanctum's speed extras (from the Paladin leveling guide — his route, take what suits us):

  • War Plan reroll: reroll the War Plan if it doesn't have 2× Helltide nodes or more up front (he even remakes the character very early if the starting plan is bad — moot for us now).
  • PvP-area chest farming: when your gear falls behind, farm the PvP area chests — he does a pass when weak, again at ~61, and again at 70 to gear up fast.
  • His difficulty stance differs from ours: he farms Maggots on Normal for speed (kills faster > per-kill XP) and skips the seasonal quest. Cliptis's ladder (what we follow) climbs Hard → Expert/Penitent. We're on Hard at 50 — decide together, but stay on the SAME difficulty as each other.

guide.title: S14: Death Awakening
guide.html:
The seasonal loop runs through Helltides, so it layers onto the plan for free. Start quest: A Gospel of Despair (read the scroll in Kyovashad).

  • Pandemonium Ruptures are rifts, most frequent in Helltides. Kill the guardians around Death's Head Idols to open one. The longer it stays open (kill monsters, close Tears), the more rewards. Rupture Goblins open extra ones anywhere.
  • Normal Ruptures: overworld / Helltides, easy — our bread and butter.
  • Surging Ruptures: replace a local event in a Helltide, chance of a Realmwalker on Mastery completion.
  • Colossal Ruptures: only in the Fields of Desecration (SE of Zarbinzet), guarantee a Realmwalker.
  • Glints of Hope: from closing Ruptures → spend at the rep board in Zarbinzet.
  • Pandemonium Fragments: seasonal currency from rep board, Resplendent Caches, Seasonal Lair Boss. Used to craft Mythic Uniques.
  • Realmwalker 2.0 → Deathtoll Chamber: mini-dungeon after a Realmwalker kill (best Superior Lair Keys). Skip while leveling.
  • The Risen: Gravehounds drop orbs that empower an Exarch — intercept the orbs.
  • Season Blessing first: spend Smoldering Ashes on Urn of Death Awakening (more Glints from all sources).
  • Freebie: Overwatch collab — Elites drop Eye of the Overwatch for free cosmetics.

guide.title: Co-op synergy
guide.html:
• Auras: Landi stays near him for Fanaticism (offense) and Defiance (survivability) — they only buff party members in range.
  • Condemn: he groups monsters + applies Vulnerable (a damage multiplier). Whirlwind the clustered, Vulnerable pack.
  • Roles: he is the tanky grouper/buffer, she is the AoE shredder. His damage ramps, hers is instant wide AoE.
  • Hell Wyrm duo: stack to melt Wyrms, or split adjacent spawns and leapfrog.
  • Decision to align: his guide skips the seasonal quest for speed, ours does it for Glints/rep. Pick one together.

guide.title: Syncing War Plans
guide.html:
Requirements, in the order that usually blocks it:

  1. Both must have War Plans unlocked (in Skovos). A fresh character that hasn't unlocked it can't sync.
  2. Be in an actual party, not just the same world.
  3. Both stand in Temis at the War Plans board.
  4. Pick “New Plan For Party” (only appears when partied) — not plain “New Plan”.
  5. Initiator pays 2 Marks of El'Druin (you each have 3). A vote pops for the other player who must actively accept.
  6. On acceptance, the initiator's board resets and copies to both. Works regardless of War Plan level, Torment, or campaign state.

Most common failures: his War Plans isn't unlocked yet, or the accept-vote popup gets missed.

guide.title: Horadric cube · crafting Mythics
guide.html:
Mythic Uniques 3.0: any Unique can become Mythic.

  • Craft at level 70 in Torment+ via Horadric Cube → Upgrade to Mythic.
  • Recipe: 850+ Unique of the same slot + 5 Pandemonium Fragments.
  • Only one crafted Mythic equipped at a time (dropped/cache ones unlimited).
  • Seasonal Lair Boss (Corrupted Reaper, Zarbinzet) has the best Mythic + Fragment drops.
  • Crafting while leveling: Tempering unlocks at level 10 (recipes per slot are in each gear tracker). From Penitent onward, use Tempering + Enchanting to patch Resistances/Armor until endgame gear replaces the need.

This is how we get: Melted Heart of Selig, Ring of Starless Skies, The Grandfather (Landi) and Mythic Fists of Fate / Endurant Faith (Nolan). Keep every 850+ Unique in the right slot as craft fodder.

guide.title: Endgame switch plan
guide.html:
• Leveling builds run all the way to 70 — no build switch at 35. (Mobalytics starts pointing Paladins at the endgame guide from 60 — the switch window is 60–70; we're going at 70, together.)
  • At 70: swap each character to its endgame build (links in Resources), starting on the Starter/Legendary variants — all aspects, no uniques required.
  • Sanctum's 70+ flow: PvP-area gear farm → temper/enchant everything → unlock Torment → farm Maggots in Torment 3 for paragon legendary nodes → then switch to the endgame build. He reckons Torment 10 within ~10 hours after that.
  • Clear Pit 10 at 60+ to unlock Torment 1 and start the ancestral/unique chase.
  • Work each gear slot up its ladder (see the gear trackers) → chase uniques from bosses → craft Mythics via the cube.
